action.label: SMT Validation
action.tooltip: Choose a properties file and validate the current model with the SMT (Z3) model finder.

command.help: Validates the currently loaded model with the SMT (Z3) model finder. A path to a properties configuration file must be given; an optional second argument selects a named section from it. The outcome and a per-invariant summary are printed directly to the shell.
command.label: SmtValidateCmd
